title: Landscape: platform sites and who already serves them
for: landscape.d and strategy.d (what it means); the players and facts are landscape.d's, the placing is my reading

sources_read.landscape: board/team/landscape.d/landscapes/platform-sites/rows.json (landscape-rows/1 with group, made 2026-11-23T06:10Z), read 23 Nov 2026; the facts and URLs are in landscape.json beside it
sources_read.cartographer: cartographer.d's reading of each group's evolution and where the groups sit; where a player sits inside its group means nothing

axes.y: visibility to the buyer (1 = what they see first)
axes.x: evolution: genesis 0, custom 0.25, product 0.5, commodity 0.75 to 1

nodes.label: Odoo
nodes.evidence: Odoo. Odoo 19 docs show an External JSON-2 API with API keys (manual or programmatic generation) and access rights; plan availability not read (page truncated). Price: not read. https://www.odoo.com/documentation/19.0/developer/reference/external_api.html (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: OpenRouter
nodes.evidence: OpenRouter. Terms bar reselling API access or building a competing service; third-party tools fall under their own terms (10.3). Price: not read. https://openrouter.ai/terms (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: AWS
nodes.evidence: AWS. AWS legal page links the Customer Agreement, Acceptable Use Policy and Trademark Guidelines; contents not read. Price: not read. https://aws.amazon.com/legal/ (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Wikipedia
nodes.evidence: Wikipedia. Text reusable under CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; credit by link to the article or history, or an author list. Price: not read. https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: OWASP Cheat Sheet Seri...
nodes.evidence: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series. Licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0; OWASP says its Markdown files are not meant to be cited externally, use the official site. Price: not read. https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: OWASP
nodes.evidence: OWASP. OWASP and Open Worldwide Application Security Project are registered trademarks of the OWASP Foundation. Price: not read. https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: OWASP Top Ten
nodes.evidence: OWASP Top Ten. Top Ten project page states no licence, only an all-rights-reserved footer; the policy licensing page returned 404. Price: not read. https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/ (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: mcp-server-odoo (ivnvx...
nodes.evidence: mcp-server-odoo (ivnvxd). MCP server letting AI assistants search, read, create, update and delete Odoo records, with opt-in workflow calls. Price: not read. https://github.com/ivnvxd/mcp-server-odoo (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Odoo MCP (tuanle96 / E...
nodes.evidence: Odoo MCP (tuanle96 / ERPipe author). Python MCP server with 41 tools for reading and aggregating Odoo data, with a gated write workflow; billed as a free AI layer for any Odoo 16+. Price: not read. https://github.com/tuanle96/mcp-odoo (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: MCP Server module (muc...
nodes.evidence: MCP Server module (much. Consulting). Odoo 19 module adding a /mcp endpoint so Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Cursor can work with Odoo records, with 17 built-in tools. Price: not read. https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/19.0/mcp_server (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Not found: Odoo AI product page
nodes.evidence: Odoo AI product page. Odoo's own page at odoo.com/app/ai returned 404, so Odoo's own AI offer is not confirmed here. Price: not read. https://www.odoo.com/app/ai (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

nodes.label: RouterChat (aurokin)
nodes.evidence: RouterChat (aurokin). Open-source chat web app for OpenRouter models with model picker, thinking mode, web search and system prompts. Price: not read. https://github.com/aurokin/routerchat (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: L0 Chat
nodes.evidence: L0 Chat. Lightweight chat client for OpenRouter, reported by search to support web search and browser-stored key; the repository page itself returned 404 on fetch. Price: not read. https://github.com/dosvic/l0-chat (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

nodes.label: Oriveo
nodes.evidence: Oriveo. Multi-model chat app (iOS, Android, web) that shows an estimated cost per reply, per OpenRouter's awesome list; own page not read. Price: not read. https://github.com/OpenRouterTeam/awesome-openrouter (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

nodes.evidence: Laminar and Helicone. Listed on OpenRouter's awesome list as tracing and observability tools covering tokens, cost and latency of OpenRouter calls; own pages not read. nodes.label: all-api-hub
nodes.evidence: all-api-hub. Listed as a browser extension for browsing models and pricing; own page not read. Price: not read. https://github.com/OpenRouterTeam/awesome-openrouter (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

nodes.label: OpenRouter own tools
nodes.evidence: OpenRouter own tools. OpenRouter's own chat page is a playground that compares several models side by side. Price: not read. https://openrouter.ai/chat (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Brows3
nodes.evidence: Brows3. Desktop client for browsing and managing objects in S3 and S3-compatible storage, with search, editor, preview and sync. Price: not read. https://github.com/rgcsekaraa/brows3 (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Filestash
nodes.evidence: Filestash. Web file manager for S3 and compatible buckets: browse, upload, edit documents, shared links without exposing keys. Price: not read. https://filestash.app/s3-browser.html (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: S3UI
nodes.evidence: S3UI. Search listing says desktop dual-pane S3 manager with cost tracking; the PyPI page was not read in detail. Price: not read. https://pypi.org/project/s3ui/ (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

nodes.label: OpenCost
nodes.evidence: OpenCost. Cost visibility for Kubernetes and cloud spend (AWS, Azure, GCP), broken down by cluster, namespace or pod. Price: not read. https://github.com/opencost/opencost (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Komiser
nodes.evidence: Komiser. Cloud resource manager for cost, usage, security and idle-resource detection across AWS and other clouds. Price: not read. https://github.com/tailwarden/komiser (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Wike
